why: The student says hello.java can be renamed to Greeting.java while keeping public class hello, but Java requires a public class to be in a file with the same name, so this is the class-name/file-name misconception.

concepts.quote: rename the file to Greeting.java and keep public class hello
concepts.why: Treats the public class name and the file name as independent, but public class hello must be in hello.java.

concepts.quote: I can rename the file to Greeting.java and keep public class hello.
concepts.why: Holds the wrong rule that the file can have any name; javac would reject Greeting.java holding public class hello.
